steps.label: opponents repeatedly charged
steps.quote: its opponents repeatedly charged that the Constitution as drafted would open the way to tyranny by the central government

steps.label: memory of the British violation
steps.quote: Fresh in their minds was the memory of the British violation of civil rights before and during the Revolution.

steps.label: bill of rights
steps.quote: They demanded a "bill of rights" that would spell out the immunities of individual citizens.

steps.label: state conventions
steps.quote: Several state conventions in their formal ratification of the Constitution asked for such amendments

steps.label: First Congress
steps.quote: the First Congress of the United States therefore proposed to the state legislatures 12 amendments to the Constitution

steps.label: first 10 amendments
steps.quote: constitute the first 10 amendments of the Constitution, known as the Bill of Rights
